snp5.7:1.1: “Alone, Sakyan, with nothing to depend on, said venerable Upasīva,
snp5.7:1.3: I am not able to cross over the great flood.
snp5.7:1.4: Please tell me of a support, All-Seeing Visionary,
snp5.7:1.5: depending on which I can cross over this flood.”
snp5.7:2.1: “Looking to nothingness, and being mindful, Upasīva, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.7:2.3: depending on nothing, cross over the flood.
snp5.7:2.4: Having given up sense pleasures, abstaining from talk,
snp5.7:2.5: day and night you must look for the end of suffering.”
snp5.7:3.1: “He who is passionless regarding all sense pleasures,
snp5.7:3.3: who is depending on nothingness, having given up all else,
snp5.7:3.4: intent on the highest freedom which still has perception -
snp5.7:3.5: will he remain there without going away?”
snp5.7:4.1: “He who is passionless regarding all sense pleasures, Upasīva, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.7:4.3: who is depending on nothingness, having given up all else,
snp5.7:4.4: intent on the highest freedom which still has perception -
snp5.7:4.5: he will remain there without going away.”
snp5.7:5.1: “If he remains there without going away
snp5.7:5.2: for a great number of years, All-Seeing Visionary,
snp5.7:5.3: will he become cool and free right there,
snp5.7:5.4: or will the consciousness of such a one fall away?”
snp5.7:6.1: “As a flame overthrown by the force of the wind, Upasīva, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.7:6.3: goes to rest and can no longer be discerned,
snp5.7:6.4: just so the Sage free from the mental body
snp5.7:6.5: goes to rest and can no longer be discerned.”
snp5.7:7.1: “The one who has come to rest, is he then nothing? said venerable Upasīva,
snp5.7:7.2: or is he actually eternally healthy?
snp5.7:7.3: Please explain this to me, O Sage,
snp5.7:7.4: for this Teaching has been understood by you.”
snp5.7:8.1: “There is no measure of the one who has come to rest, Upasīva, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.7:8.3: there is nothing by which they can speak of him,
snp5.7:8.4: when everything has been completely removed,
snp5.7:8.5: all the pathways for speech are also completely removed.”
